description: Employers whose name matches, best first. Each result carries its PERM record and the slug that the get endpoint takes. Example: {"q":"acme"}.

limit.description: Results to return, 1 to 100. 10 when left out. Example: 25.

q.description: 2 to 120 characters of the name. Example: acme.

name: search_employers

asOf.description: The date the data is true for, YYYY-MM-DD, when one applies.

anyOf.description: Employers, law firms or occupations found by name.

more.description: True when more matched than the limit returned. Send more of the name to narrow it.

items.description: One employer, law firm or occupation, with its PERM record.

certifiedShare.description: certified / (certified + denied), from 0 to 1. Null under the site's floor of decided cases.

filingsLast12Months.description: PERM cases filed in the last 12 months.

kind.description: What the record is: an employer, a law firm (attorney) or an occupation.

medianAnnualWage.description: Occupations only: the median offered wage, a year, in dollars.

medianDaysToDecision.description: Median days from filing to decision.

name.description: The name as DOL's files print it most often.

occupationCode.description: Occupations only: the SOC code, e.g. 15-1252.

publishedCases.description: PERM cases in DOL's published files: decided ones, so certified, denied or withdrawn.

rankByVolume.description: Its rank by number of PERM cases, 1 being the most.

slug.description: The record's name in its page's address. Send it to the matching get endpoint.

state.description: Law firms only: the firm's state, two letters.

anyOf.description: No such record. Say so; don't retry the same call.

message.description: What wasn't found and what to try, in a sentence.

data.description: The answer, or found: false when no record matched.

page.description: The page on permtracker.app that shows the same thing. Cite it.

title: Search employers by name
